papers.title: EquiBot
papers.text_en: We study how to learn manipulation policies from limited demonstrations that generalize across objects and scenes. EquiBot combines SIM(3)-equivariant neural networks with diffusion models, allowing the policy to handle changes in scale, rotation, and translation while retaining multimodal action prediction. Across six simulation tasks, EquiBot reduces data requirements and improves generalization to novel scenarios. In real-world experiments, it generalizes to ten variations of six mobile manipulation tasks after five minutes of human demonstrations per task.
papers.text_zh: 我们研究如何仅凭少量示范学习出能够跨物体和场景泛化的机器人操作策略。EquiBot 将 SIM(3) 等变神经网络与扩散模型结合，使策略能够应对尺度、旋转和平移变化，同时保留多模态动作预测能力。在六项模拟任务上，EquiBot 用更少的数据实现了更好的新场景泛化。在真实环境中，每项任务仅使用五分钟的人类示范，策略便能泛化到六项移动操作任务的十种变化。

papers.title: Sparsh
papers.text_en: We introduce general-purpose touch representations for vision-based tactile sensors. Existing systems often rely on task- and sensor-specific models, while collecting labels for forces and slip at scale is difficult. Sparsh uses self-supervised pretraining on more than 460k tactile images and introduces TacBench, a six-task benchmark spanning tactile properties, physical perception, and manipulation planning. Under limited labeled-data budgets, self-supervised pretraining outperforms task- and sensor-specific end-to-end training on average; DINO and I-JEPA are the most competitive objectives, highlighting the value of latent-space learning for touch.
papers.text_zh: 我们提出面向视觉触觉传感器的通用触觉表征。现有系统往往需要针对任务和传感器分别建模，而力和滑移等标注数据难以大规模采集。Sparsh 在 46 万多张触觉图像上进行自监督预训练，并构建 TacBench 六任务基准，覆盖触觉属性、物理感知和操作规划。在有限标注数据下，自监督预训练整体优于任务和传感器特定的端到端训练；DINO 和 I-JEPA 是其中最具竞争力的目标，说明在潜在空间中学习触觉表征具有价值。

papers.title: ManiWAV
papers.text_en: Contact audio can reveal interaction events and object properties that are ambiguous in vision. However, audio in robot manipulation is often collected through teleoperation with a microphone attached to the robot or object, limiting scalable data collection. ManiWAV introduces an ear-in-hand device for collecting in-the-wild human demonstrations with synchronized audio and vision, together with a policy interface that learns robot manipulation directly from these demonstrations. We evaluate the system on four contact-rich manipulation tasks involving passive sensing of contact events and modes as well as active sensing of surface materials and object states, and show generalization to unseen in-the-wild environments.
papers.text_zh: 接触声音可以揭示视觉难以判断的交互事件和物体属性。然而，机器人操作中的音频通常通过遥操作采集，并将麦克风安装在机器人或物体上，这限制了可扩展的数据采集。ManiWAV 提出一种“耳朵装在手上”的装置，用于在真实环境中采集同步的音频和视觉人类示范；同时，配套的策略接口可以直接从这些示范中学习机器人操作。我们在四项接触丰富的操作任务上评估系统，涵盖对接触事件和模式的被动感知，以及对表面材质和物体状态的主动感知，并展示了从未见环境示范中学习后的泛化能力。

papers.title: PoliFormer
papers.text_en: We present PoliFormer, an RGB-only indoor navigation agent trained end-to-end with large-scale on-policy reinforcement learning in simulation that transfers to the real world without adaptation. PoliFormer combines a foundation vision transformer with a causal transformer decoder to support long-term memory and reasoning, and uses parallel multi-machine rollouts to train on hundreds of millions of interactions across diverse environments. It achieves strong results across two robot embodiments and four navigation benchmarks, including an 85.5% success rate on CHORES-S, a 28.5-point absolute improvement. PoliFormer also extends to object tracking, multi-object navigation, and open-vocabulary navigation without finetuning.
papers.text_zh: 我们提出 PoliFormer，一种仅使用 RGB、在仿真中通过大规模同策略强化学习端到端训练的室内导航智能体，即使不做适应也能迁移到真实世界。PoliFormer 将视觉基础模型与因果 Transformer 解码器结合，以支持长期记忆和推理，并通过并行的多机轨迹采集，在多样环境中进行数亿次交互训练。该方法在两种机器人和四个导航基准上取得了较强结果，其中在 CHORES-S 上达到 85.5% 的成功率，绝对提升 28.5 个百分点。此外，PoliFormer 无需微调即可扩展到目标跟踪、多目标导航和开放词汇导航。

papers.title: OKAMI
papers.text_en: We study how to teach humanoid robots manipulation skills from a single video demonstration. OKAMI generates a manipulation plan from a single RGB-D video and retargets it to a humanoid while adapting to different object locations during deployment. Its object-aware retargeting pipeline uses open-world vision models to identify task-relevant objects and transfers body motions and hand poses separately, allowing the robot to reproduce the demonstrated interaction under changing layouts. Experiments show strong generalization across visual and spatial conditions and outperform the open-world imitation baseline. OKAMI rollouts can further train closed-loop visuomotor policies, which achieve 79.2% average success without labor-intensive teleoperation.
papers.text_zh: 我们研究如何让人形机器人仅通过观看一段人类视频学会操作技能。OKAMI 从单段 RGB-D 视频生成操作计划，并在执行时根据物体位置将人体动作重定向到人形机器人。其物体感知重定向流程使用开放世界视觉模型识别任务相关物体，并分别传递身体动作和手部姿态，使机器人能够在不同布局下复现示范中的交互。实验表明，OKAMI 在视觉和空间条件变化下具有较强泛化能力，并优于开放世界模仿基线。进一步地，OKAMI 生成的轨迹还可用于训练闭环视觉运动策略，在无需繁重人工遥操作的情况下达到 79.2% 的平均成功率。
